title.zh: 关于授予打拉省Victoria市镇Cabuluan村各项权利的法案
title.en: An Act Granting the Barrio of Cabuluan in the Municipality of Victoria, Province of Tarlac
title.orig: An Act Granting the Barrio of Cabuluan in the Municipality of Victoria, Province of Tarlac

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2818_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Cabuluan in the Municipality of Victoria, Province of Tarlac, is converted into a barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Cabuluan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
